description: Fix critical bugs discovered during first Silver deployment that prevent Bronze data from being parsed and normalized correctly
steps: Fix decompress_jsonl and iter_jsonl in core/compression.py: replace text.splitlines() with text.split('\n') to avoid splitting on Unicode line separators (U+2028, U+2029) embedded inside JSON string values from API data
Fix PolymarketMarketsNormalizer to accept camelCase field names from Gamma API (updatedAt, endDateIso, conditionId, clobTokenIds) in addition to snake_case
Fix PolymarketEventsNormalizer to accept camelCase field names and add endDate fallback when updatedAt and endDateIso are both null
Fix dedup_key methods on both Polymarket normalizers to use camelCase field lookups
Wire skip_quality_checks parameter from CLI through _run_process to process_manifest in processor.py (parameter was defined but never passed)
Add unit tests for U+2028/U+2029 handling in decompress_jsonl
Add unit tests for camelCase Gamma API records in both normalizers

description: Fix quality check framework to handle catalog entities (markets, events) which are full snapshots containing records with timestamps spanning years, not scoped to a single day
steps: Analyze timestamp_range check behavior for catalog entities: a full markets snapshot for dt=2026-02-03 contains 382K records with updatedAt timestamps from 2023 through 2026 — the current ±1 day window rejects 97% of records
Design entity-type-aware quality check configuration: catalog entities (markets, events) should either skip timestamp_range or use a much wider acceptable range
Update checks_for_entity() in quality.py to return appropriate checks based on entity type (stream vs catalog)
Ensure trades/order_filled (stream entities) retain strict timestamp_range checks
Add tests verifying catalog entities pass quality checks without --skip-quality-checks flag

description: Redesign Bronze ingestion and Silver processing model to support continuous/frequent ingestion where new records arrive throughout the day, not just once-daily batch snapshots
steps: [DONE] Document current limitation: order_filled ingestion reuses one run_id per dt partition, overwrites manifest after each batch flush, and Silver state store marks run_id as processed — so mid-day processing freezes Silver at that point in time
[DONE] Design new ingestion model: each ingest cycle (catchup invocation) produces an independent run_id and manifest, making each batch independently processable by Silver
[DONE] Update order_filled ingest to generate a new run_id per catchup invocation instead of reusing the same run_id for an entire day
[DONE] Update manifest semantics: each manifest is self-contained and append-only to Silver (no full-day reprocessing needed)
[DONE] Update Silver processor to handle multiple manifests per dt partition as incremental appends rather than full replacements
[DONE] Update Silver state store to track per-manifest processing (not per-day)
[DONE] Handle deduplication across multiple manifests for the same dt: ensure Silver dedup catches records that appear in overlapping ingestion windows

description: Process historical order_filled Bronze data into Silver trades, validating the full trade derivation pipeline end-to-end with real data at scale
steps: [DONE] Verify PolymarketTradesNormalizer wiring in processor: ensure MarketsReferenceLookup is automatically loaded from Bronze markets data before trade normalization begins

[DONE] Implement automatic MarketsReferenceLookup loading in processor.py: when processing trades, load_markets_reference() builds the token-to-market mapping from Bronze markets manifests, scoped to end_date=dt
Test trade derivation with a small sample of real order_filled Bronze data (1 day) and validate price, amounts, and market resolution
Process full historical order_filled backlog into Silver trades (end-of-day model for completed days only)
Validate Silver trades row counts against Bronze order_filled manifests

[DONE] Handle edge cases: empty markets reference raises ProcessingError with clear message; individual order_filled records that fail token lookup are logged and skipped via NormalizationError (normalize_batch skip-on-failure behavior)

description: Define and implement the production scheduling model for Bronze ingestion and Silver processing triggers
steps: Define production cadence for each entity type: catalog entities (markets, events) = daily full snapshot, stream entities (trades/order_filled) = every N minutes or on-demand catchup
Implement end-of-day Silver processing trigger: Silver processes yesterday's complete data each morning for stream entities
Implement same-day Silver processing for catalog entities: markets/events snapshots can be processed immediately after ingestion completes
Add CLI command or flag to process only 'closed' days (days before today) to prevent processing incomplete partitions
Document the production cron schedule and operational runbook for daily Silver processing
Design future path for near-real-time Silver (independent run_id per cycle) vs current end-of-day batch model

description: Integration tests and validation for the production ingestion model changes
steps: Integration test: ingest order_filled with multiple catchup cycles producing independent run_ids, then process all into Silver and verify dedup correctness
Integration test: verify Silver trades processing correctly loads MarketsReferenceLookup and resolves token IDs
Integration test: process catalog entity (markets) without --skip-quality-checks after quality check fix
Test idempotency: re-running Silver process on already-processed manifests should be a no-op (state store check)
Test concurrent ingestion safety: verify two catchup runs for overlapping time windows produce correct Silver output
Run mypy and ruff on all changed modules
